test_title: PYST 17 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A and B together can complete a work in 12 days. If A alone can complete the work in 20 days, how many days will B alone take to complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A + B = 12 days

A = 20 days

**Calculation:**

Let total work = LCM of 12 and 20 = 60

⇒ (A + B) efficiency = 60 / 12 = 5 units/day

⇒ A efficiency = 60 / 20 = 3 units/day

⇒ B efficiency = 5 − 3 = 2 units/day

⇒ Time taken by B = 60 / 2 = 30 days

**∴ B alone will complete the work in 30 days**
